resources.string: UV forecasts and sunrise/sunset times are provided by Open-Meteo.
Place names are looked up using Nominatim, based on OpenStreetMap data.
UVApp formats and groups forecasts for display and uses UV values to calculate exposure estimates. These estimates are calculated by UVApp, not supplied by the data providers.
SPF is recorded for reference only. It is not used in the exposure countdown and does not extend the estimated exposure time.
Exposure time is an estimate based on UV, skin type and detected surroundings. It does not guarantee a safe time in the sun.
Sound level helps classify your surroundings. Microphone sampling runs only while the app is visible. Audio recordings are not saved.
Your time in the sun this week

The Fitzpatrick scale describes how skin reacts to sunlight. Choose the type that best matches your past sunburn and tanning reactions, alongside your natural skin colour. Do not deliberately expose your skin to test it.
Burns very easily and does not tan.
Burns easily and tans only slightly.
Sometimes burns and gradually develops a light tan.
Burns less easily and tans readily.
Rarely burns and tans easily and deeply.
Deeply pigmented skin that is usually less prone to sunburn.
All skin types need sun protection. A lower tendency to burn does not mean protection from UV damage. This guide supports self-selection; it is not a medical assessment.
